title: Study: More Than 800 Million Have Diabetes Worldwide, Many Untreated
speaker: VOA Learning English

sentences.en: A new study reports that more than 800 million adults have diabetes worldwide.
sentences.zh: 一项新的研究报告说,全世界有8亿多成年人患有糖尿病。

sentences.en: And more than half of those aged over 30 who have the condition are not receiving treatment.
sentences.zh: 超过一半的30岁以上有这种病症的人没有接受治疗。

sentences.en: Diabetes is a disease in which your blood sugar level is too high.
sentences.zh: 糖尿病是一种血液糖含量过高的疾病。

sentences.en: If untreated, it can damage the heart, blood vessels, nerves and other organs.
sentences.zh: 如果未经治疗,会损害心脏、血管、神经和其他器官。

sentences.en: The study, recently published in the publication Lancet , found that around 828 million people aged 18 and older had diabetes worldwide in 2022.
sentences.zh: 最近刊登在《柳叶刀》杂志上的这项研究发现,2022年全世界约有8.28亿18岁及18岁以上的人患糖尿病。

sentences.en: Among those 30 and older, the study said 445 million, or 59 percent, were not receiving treatment.
sentences.zh: 在这30岁以上的人中,研究表明有4.45亿人,即59%没有接受治疗。

sentences.en: The study was done by the NCD Risk Factor Collaboration and the World Health Organization (WHO).
sentences.zh: 这项研究是由非传染性疾病风险因素协作组织和世界卫生组织(世卫组织)进行的。

sentences.en: It is the first worldwide evaluation based on more than 1,000 studies involving more than 140 million people.
sentences.zh: 这是根据涉及1.4亿多人的1 000多项研究进行的第一次全球评价。

sentences.en: Shocking increase The WHO estimated that the number of people living with diabetes worldwide rose from 200 million in 1990 to about 830 million in 2022.
sentences.zh: 卫生组织估计全世界糖尿病患者人数从1990年的2亿增加到2022年的8.3亿。

sentences.en: The study’s researchers say the increase has been caused largely by rising cases in low- and middle- income countries.
sentences.zh: 该研究的研究人员说,增加的主要原因是中低收入国家的病例增加。

sentences.en: Treatments in those countries have not kept up with the rise, while the situation has improved in some higher-income countries.
sentences.zh: 这些国家的治疗没有跟上上升趋势,而一些高收入国家的情况则有所改善。

sentences.en: WHO Director-General Dr. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said in a statement that the increase shown in the study was shocking. “To bring the global diabetes epidemic under control, countries must urgently take action," he said.
sentences.zh: 世界卫生组织总干事特德罗斯·阿德汉诺姆·格布雷耶斯博士在一份声明中说,研究显示的增长令人震惊。 他说,“为了控制全球糖尿病流行病,各国必须采取紧急行动。 ”

sentences.en: Those actions should include policies supporting healthy diets and physical activity, as well as health systems that can prevent, identify and treat the condition.
sentences.zh: 这些行动应包括支持健康饮食和体育活动的政策,以及能够预防、识别和治疗疾病的卫生系统。

sentences.en: Treating the disease is costly Jean Claude Mbanya is a professor at the University of Yaounde I in Cameroon.
sentences.zh: 治疗这一疾病的费用高昂,Jean Claude Mbanya是喀麦隆雅温得第一大学的教授。

sentences.en: He said that in parts of sub-Saharan Africa, only 5-10 percent of those estimated to have diabetes were getting treatment.
sentences.zh: 他说,在撒哈拉以南非洲部分地区,只有5%-10%估计患有糖尿病的人得到治疗。

sentences.en: He added that treating diabetes, either with insulin or drugs, can be costly.
sentences.zh: 他还说,用胰岛素或药物治疗糖尿病可能费用高昂。

sentences.en: "A huge number (are) at risk of serious health complications," he said.
sentences.zh: 他说,“有大批人面临严重的健康问题的危险”。

sentences.en: Some of the largest improvements, 25 to 37 percentage points, happened in countries in Latin America, central and western Europe, Canada, South Korea, Russia, Seychelles, and Jordan.
sentences.zh: 拉丁美洲、中欧和西欧、加拿大、南朝鲜、俄罗斯、塞舌尔和约旦等国取得了一些最大的改善,即25%至37%。

sentences.en: The WHO says the number of deaths caused by diabetes has been increasing since 2000.
sentences.zh: 卫生组织说,自2000年以来,糖尿病造成的死亡人数一直在增加。

sentences.en: In 2021, the disease was the direct cause of 1.6 million deaths.
sentences.zh: 2021年,这一疾病是160万人死亡的直接原因。

sentences.en: Symptoms and prevention The health agency says symptoms of diabetes may happen suddenly or take many years to be noticed.
sentences.zh: 健康机构说,糖尿病的症状可能突然发生,或者需要多年才能发现。

sentences.en: They include: The best way to prevent or delay the illness, the WHO says, is to make lifestyle changes.
sentences.zh: 卫生组织说,预防或推迟这种疾病的最佳办法是改变生活方式。

sentences.zh: 例如:我是吉尔·罗宾斯。

sentences.zh: Jennifer Rigby为路透社报导了这个故事。
